updater: Connect / back up / install or restore page. Transfer engine unchanged from the hardware-tested uploader.
scope: Headless Chrome 155 (Playwright 1.62.1) with the page's simulated RD-6 only; no MIDI access or device writes
cases: Install blocked until connected, the 1.0.5 question is answered, the backup is saved and confirmed, and experimental firmware is acknowledged
Backup of an RD-6 reporting 1.0.5 is the exact official 1.0.5 file, labelled as not a device dump
One-click Scatter v1.4 install: update-mode entry with port absent/present and two ACKs, 378 firmware ACKs, byte-exact stream, version reply 1.0.5
After installing, the RD-6 is known to run Scatter, with nothing to back up
Saved backup restores exact stock 1.0.5 and verifies 1.0.5
Official 1.0.6 restore needs no file and verifies 1.0.6; identity accepts 1.0.6
Reinstalling Scatter from 1.0.6 asks for a new 1.0.6 backup, then verifies 1.0.5
Restore files from the previous updater and official .syx files accepted
Damaged backup clears the previous file and blocks restore; unrelated JSON refused
Application-mode reply to the handshake refused after one read-only query
RD-6 that ignores update-mode entry receives no setup or firmware frames
NACK, timeout and duplicate ACK at block 120 abort without retry, block sent once, with partial-write advice and a fresh check required
Missed USB re-enumeration: read-only 08 40 confirms update mode before the transfer
Stop needs a second click without pausing the transfer, then ends it after the current block with partial-write advice
Tampered patch rejected by the pinned target hash
Modified firmware needs a typed checksum confirmation; a wrong confirmation keeps it blocked
Confirmed unrecognised file is written and then treated as unrecognised firmware
Connection lost after the mode switch: stops before any setup or firmware frame, explains it and offers Reconnect
Reconnect reloads the page, keeps the choices and the failed run's log, and connects again
Connection lost after a complete write: says all firmware was written; after Reconnect the expected version confirms the new firmware is running
Patterns and settings backup reads all 32 patterns and the six settings with read-only requests (77, 75) and a matching checksum
Patterns and settings restore writes every pattern (78) and setting back exactly, ACK by ACK, and never sends firmware commands
Edited, damaged or wrong-type patterns files are refused
A NACK part-way through a patterns restore stops at once and reports how many patterns were restored
No answer while reading patterns saves nothing and offers Reconnect; update mode blocks patterns backup and restore
